purpose: Generated resolved connection description; edit source declarations or compiled resources, then refresh.

coordinate_convention.heading: outward; 0 degrees north, clockwise in plan view
coordinate_convention.slope: outward rise/run at the edge; percent = 100 * grade

piece.purpose: Authoritative build definition and permanent game-resource identity for DD RHW-4 — L2 Exit Slip Lanes — Parallel — Alignment B.
piece.name: DD RHW-4 — L2 Exit Slip Lanes — Parallel — Alignment B
piece.description: Place one l2 exit slip lanes for Alignment B of the close parallel diagonal diamond. Use the complete connection cards and assembly grid; heights are fixed.

engineering.path_ownership: Every full native and ramp fragment in each owned city cell
engineering.reuse_limit: Half-grid recutting changes complete native and ramp PATH ownership; no Alignment A whole type is substituted

provenance.geometry: Reviewed complementary grid phase: authored ramps translate 8 m east and 8 m north; unchanged directed DD phase and adjacent Avenue phase are independently recut into minimum whole-cell traffic owners.
provenance.construction: Disjoint whole-cell traffic owners; separate physical models may overhang neighbouring cells.

connections.purpose: Intrinsic saved-resource endpoints, service roles, directed journeys, and forbidden transfers for one piece.

source.scope: one piece only; no counterpart catalogue is consulted
